flaps._comment: Embraer E175 (ERJ-170-200) has 7 lever positions: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, FULL. Speed values are provisional E175-family compatibility values pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification. In MSFS add-ons, FULL may be represented as a separate 7th detent or merged with position 5; the handle-index order needs in-sim verification.

grades._comment: Provisional E175 landing-rate bands pending aircraft-specific source verification.

engines._comment: Exact CF34 idle and limit N1 percentages are intentionally omitted pending a reviewable Embraer or engine-manufacturer source.

telemetry._comment: No FSS-specific telemetry route is active. Standard SimConnect remains the only live path pending vendor documentation and in-sim verification.

controls._comment: No aircraft-specific RPN toggle or relative rotary action is active. Exact command semantics require vendor documentation and in-simulator verification.

meta.notes: FlightSim Studio Embraer E170/175 compatibility profile. The canonical profile id is fss-e175 because the target aircraft is the FlightSim Studio E-Jets add-on, not an Asobo aircraft. Powered by GE Aviation CF34-8E5 turbofan engines. Weight data from Embraer E175 Specifications and EASA TCDS EASA.IM.A.071 Issue 26. Flap and gear speed values are provisional E175-family compatibility values pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification. AR variant (Advanced Range) weights used as upper bound. Also covers ERJ-170-100 (E170), which shares similar systems but lower certified weights.

sources.name: Embraer E175 Commercial Specifications
sources.notes: Documents the E175 LR/AR MTOW, MLW, MZFW, performance envelope, and E175 product identity used by this profile.

sources.name: MSFS 2020/2024 Aircraft List
sources.notes: Identifies the MSFS Embraer EMB 170/175 Short Wing add-on as a FlightSim Studio aircraft with ICAO designator E75S.

sources.name: FlightSim Studio E-Jets Hardware Integration
sources.notes: Official FlightSim Studio E-Jets hardware-integration page confirms external hardware integration support, but it does not itself publish a vendor-maintained exact variable contract.

knownIssues: Flap and gear speed values are provisional and need redistributable public-source or vendor verification before promotion.
FULL may be a separate seventh handle detent rather than sharing position 5; the index mapping needs in-sim verification
Aircraft-specific MCP readbacks remain inactive pending vendor documentation and in-sim verification of exact semantics.
FSS autopilot input records require RPN/relative rotary handling, so no active custom control writes are mapped yet
This profile also covers the E170 (ERJ-170-100) which shares nearly identical systems but has lower MTOW (37,200 kg LR / 38,790 kg AR)
